request.acceptance_criteria: [1] health.verdict is healthy/degraded/stopped with recovered counts per the rules; `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestVerdict|TestCost|TestTheContract' ./internal/statusmodel/` passes. [2] No cost line is ever metered:false with a number; unmetered claude/pi-local/workers-ai spend is a line with usd null, and a cloud run's gateway cost is metered. [3] `make gate` passes.
request.description:
Epic hn6, wave 2: fill the two run-level verdicts the dashboard header shows. (1) The health VERDICT goes in internal/statusmodel/verdict.go (`buildVerdict`). (2) The honest COST lines go in internal/statusmodel/cost.go (`buildCost`). Both are pure functions of Sources, Records, the feed and the Model built so far.

The wave-1 contract tick declared the fields: Health.verdict {state healthy|degraded|stopped, summary, recovered[{what,count,seconds}]} and Cost.lines [{source decisions|workers-ai|claude|pi-local|other, metered, usd (null when unmetered), attempts, basis}]. Read their doc comments in internal/statusmodel/statusmodel.go and the "dashboard" golden in contract.json first.

The hn6 rules this implements:
- Rule 3: health is a verdict, not raw counters: "healthy (recovered: …)" / "degraded: …" / "stopped: …". The raw counts stay in Health's existing counters.
- Rule 7: cost is honest. It is metered where measured and says "not metered" where not (local claude on Max, local pi/GLM if unmeasured). Never a fabricated $0.00.
- The first-use bug: the header said "cost $0.00 recorded (10 attempts)" while local pi/GLM and claude spend went uncounted.

Verdict rules (feed stage constants are in internal/reconcile, e.g. reconcile.StageRemoteRetried):
- stopped: liveness not alive AND the lifecycle phase is not done or cancelled (a dead run or a failed run). The summary is liveness.reason, or else the waits_on.what of a dead-run wait.
- degraded: alive, AND any of:
  - m.Degraded is non-empty;
  - a worker has a `stuck_nudged` line for its current attempt with no later activity line for that attempt;
  - a `remote_exhausted` line exists;
  - a `stall_warned` line exists in the last 15 minutes (measured against src.Now).
  The summary names the first cause in that order, e.g. "degraded: forge unreadable" or "degraded: v7z nudged as stuck 4m ago".
- healthy: otherwise, with summary "healthy".
- recovered (listed in any state): {what:"net", count: number of remote_retried lines} when >0; {what:"sleep", count: number of host_suspended lines, seconds: the sum of the suspension durations when the lines' details state them, else null} when >0; {what:"interventions", count: resumed_automatically lines} when >0; {what:"wall clocks", count} when >0. The renderer prints these as "(recovered: net ×14, sleep 41m)". An empty list when nothing recovered.

Cost rules: group recs.Attempts by source, deciding the source from each attempt's Provenance (Executor, Model; see buildTick in build.go for where they come from):
- Model starting "cloudflare-workers-ai/", or executor "cloudflare-sandbox" → workers-ai.
- Executor or harness kind claude (a model like "opus"/"sonnet", or the attempt's kind) → claude.
- Harness pi with any other model → pi-local.
- Anything else → other.
Then:
- decisions line: metered, usd = the existing sum of decision usage.cost_usd; attempts = number of decisions carrying usage. Omit the line when there are no decisions.
- workers-ai line: metered with usd = src.WorkerCost.USD when src.WorkerCost != nil (a cloud run, from the factory's gateway-backed cost_usd), basis "AI Gateway logs". Otherwise metered:false, usd:null, basis "not metered: this run's Workers AI calls are not joined to gateway logs".
- claude line: always metered:false, basis "not metered (subscription)".
- pi-local and other: metered:false, basis "not metered".
Keep recorded_usd equal to the sum of the metered lines' usd. Never emit metered:false with a number. Add a code comment stating rule 7.

Files: internal/statusmodel/verdict.go, internal/statusmodel/cost.go, and new tests internal/statusmodel/verdict_test.go and internal/statusmodel/cost_test.go. Nothing else.

Tests (named TestVerdict* and TestCost*):
- Verdict cases: (a) alive with no warnings → healthy, recovered []; (b) 14 remote_retried + 2 host_suspended → healthy with recovered net ×14 and sleep ×2; (c) degraded forge → degraded, with a summary naming it; (d) an unresolved stuck nudge → degraded; (e) not alive with phase waves → stopped; (f) done and not alive → NOT stopped.
- Cost cases: (a) local attempts on claude + pi GLM with no decisions → two unmetered lines, recorded_usd 0, and the JSON has no line with metered:false and a number; (b) cloud with WorkerCost 0.41 → workers-ai metered 0.41; (c) decisions with cost → decisions line metered.
- Every case's Build output still validates against the contract, via the contract_test.go helper.

Run: `go test -short -timeout 20m -run 'TestVerdict|TestCost|TestTheContract' ./internal/statusmodel/`. Must still pass: `go test -short -timeout 20m ./internal/statusmodel/ ./internal/cli/`, and then `make gate`.
request.title: Status model states a health verdict and honest cost lines
